sentences.japanese: その老人はその王に何年も仕えた。
sentences.english: The old man served the king for many years.

sentences.japanese: その時以来彼女はずっと彼に仕えた。
sentences.english: From that time on, she always waited on him.

sentences.japanese: 彼女は献身的に病身の父親に仕えた。
sentences.english: She waited on her sick father hand and foot.

sentences.japanese: 彼らはなぜあんなに卑屈に彼に仕えたのか。
sentences.english: Why did they wait upon him so servilely?
